<b>Silk and Soul</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] from the [[Caretaker]] for assistance in the creation of a powerful trap with which to ensnare the [[Grand Mother Silk|monarch]] of [[Pharloom]].

== Requirements ==
In order to unlock the quest, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must first complete the following:<ref><code>Soul Snare</code> in <code>dataassets/questsystem/completetotalgroups.bundle</code>.</ref>

<i>Note: This list only shows the final Wish or Item required. Requirements to unlock each Wish or Item are listed on their individual pages.</i>

=== Wishes ===
* <i>[[Flexile Spines]]</i>
* <i>[[A Lifesaving Bridge]]</i>
* <i>[[Crawbug Clearing]]</i>
* <i>[[Strengthening Songclave]]</i>
* <i>[[Trail's End]]</i>
* <i>[[Balm for the Wounded]]</i>

=== Items ===
* [[Faydown Cloak]]
* [[Bellhome Key]]

=== Miscellaneous ===
* Move the [[Flea Caravan]] to [[Fleatopia]].
* Defeat [[Lace]] in [[the Cradle]].

=== Quest Points ===
A minimum of <b>17 "Quest Points"</b> is required to unlock <i>Silk and Soul</i>. There are 25 possible Quest Points: 22 points from normal Wishes and 3 points from 6 delivery Wishes, which only give points the first time they are completed.

Once Hornet completes all the requirements, she may then take up the Wish from the [[Wishwalls|Wishwall]] in [[Bellhart]] or by speaking to the [[Caretaker]] in [[Songclave]].

== The Soul Snare ==
Hornet must collect the following items:
* [[Maiden's Soul]], given by [[Chapel Maid]] in [[Bone Bottom]].
* [[Hermit's Soul]], given by [[Bell Hermit]] in [[Bellhart]].
* [[Seeker's Soul]], found on a Snail Shaman's corpse after defeating [[Groal the Great]] in [[Bilewater]].
* [[Snare Setter]], found in [[Weavenest Atla]] in a hidden workshop.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Chapel Maid 01.png!Maiden's Soul location in Bone Bottom
| Image2 = Mapshot SS Bell Hermit 01.png!Hermit's Soul location in Bellhart
| Image3 = Mapshot SS Seeker's Soul.png!Seeker's Soul location in Bilewater
| Image4 = Mapshot SS Snare Setter 01.png!Snare Setter location in Weavenest Atla
}}

Once the items have been gathered and given to the Caretaker, the <i>[[DESTROY: Soul Snare]]</i> [[Objectives|objective]] begins, and Hornet must ascend the Cradle once more to fight [[Grand Mother Silk]]. The boss fight is identical during this wish, but while delivering the final blow, Hornet is given the option to play the [[Needolin]] instead of binding the boss. Doing so entraps Grand Mother Silk with the Soul Snare, granting the <i>Snared Silk</i> [[Achievements (Silksong)|achievement]] and triggering its [[Endings (Silksong)#Ending 2: Snared Silk|ending]].

{{Disclaimer|Triggering the <i>Snared Silk</i> ending permanently locks out the <i>[[Endings (Silksong)#Ending 1: Weaver Queen|Weaver Queen]]</i> and the <i>[[Endings (Silksong)#Ending 3: Twisted Child|Twisted Child]]</i> endings on that [[Save Data (Silksong)|save profile]].}}
